name: Hall of Triumph
desc: A climate-controlled gallery and reserve berth complex for storied vessels. Ships placed in its dedicated storage become trophies whose legends are refined into occasional story points.

name: Wreck Farms
desc: Salvager families maintain hereditary claims over the dense orbital wreck fields surrounding the Ring. Tug crews herd drifting hulks into safer plots, where cutters and yard crews strip them for metals, machinery, supplies, and reusable hull sections.
